title: Garbage
text: Garbage. I originally gave this fan a good review but that has changed because I have used it for about a week and a half. Turns out it’s just like all the other Chinese garbage on here. Randomly shuts off, won’t charge, won’t even turn on half the time. Do yourself a favor and try a different brand because this one is awful.
